item: WORK_QUEUE A-#10 / HYPO G9 — AF2 K2 vintage-flip test machinery
law: flip counts are data-quality facts (label stability), not strategy returns; no PnL; PB3 PARK untouched; owner real-time rates decision outstanding regardless
k2_kill_rule: recompute the differential with year-end ALFRED vintages as-of each roll; >=3/16 material-roll sign flips => the conditioning variable is vintage-fragile => AF2 dead (JPY_AUD_HYPOTHESES §5.7 K2; 6E +0.91→−0.11 flip is the named bar)

baseline_committed_latest_vintage.caveat_committed: RBA table = as-published decisions (gate HTML); DFF = FRED latest vintage (ALFRED year-end vintages only in corpus) -> CIP check is latest-vintage, not strict-PIT vintages; overnight rates are a proxy (no 3m AUD series in corpus; DTB3 exists for US only)
baseline_committed_latest_vintage.note: on the latest-vintage basis the flip count is 0 by construction (single basis) — 16/16 material sign match is the FLOOR the K2 test stress-tests

machinery.asof_rule: for roll date d: latest vintage with as-of stamp <= d, then that vintage's own nearest observation <= d (identical to the committed a7_6e §6 6E method); differential = RBA_effective(d) − DFF_vintage(d); RBA table revision-free (as-published effective dates)

synthetic_fixture_proof.fixture_law: 6 rolls, RBA flat 1.50, latest DFF 1.00 (all material, diff +0.50); one vintage table (as-of 2020-12-31) with INJECTED opposite-sign observations (DFF 2.00) on rolls #3 (2021-06-01) and #5 (2021-12-01); rolls #1/#2/#4/#6 carry the same-sign vintage value (DFF 1.00)
synthetic_fixture_proof.note: proves the as-of selection + material band + flip counter recover exactly the injected flips; the >=3/16 kill rule is evaluated but never adjudicated on synthetic data

synthetic_fixture_null.fixture_law: vintage identical to latest (no injected flips)
